release_notes:
BD MIL OFFICE 1.0.10 — 1 Oct 2026

New
- Pext tab. The extracted text box lives here, so PDF Edit gives the viewer the whole screen.
- Scanner is now the second tab, next to PDF Edit.
- Burst Stack. Scan a pile with a blank sheet between each document, tap once, and each one is saved as its own PDF.
- Legal page size added to scan export.

Fixed
- Scan Library now survives closing the app, and can no longer be wiped when the saved list cannot be read.
- Scan export settings — quality, page size, page numbers, watermark — are remembered.
- Full screen in PDF Edit works again.
- Signatures and stamps burn exactly where you place them, including zoomed in, near a page break, or on a rotated page.
- The green confirm tick is always reachable, and a new red button discards a signature without burning it.
- Placing a signature no longer throws away unsaved handwriting without asking.
- Your page and your last edit are saved the moment you leave the app.
- PowerPoint pictures no longer flicker.
- In landscape, buttons no longer hide behind the navigation bar.
- Light and dark now follow the system straight away, menus and dialogs included.
- Very large PDFs warn you before editing instead of closing the app.
- Clean temporary files now reclaims leftover scan pages.

Privacy
- No ads, no tracking. The camera permission, leftover advertising code, the advertising ID permission and an unused API key are all gone.

Notes
- Excel files are no longer offered to open, because the app cannot open them. CSV and .ppsx open properly.
- If the update fails, uninstall the previous version and install this one.
